title: SA-MIL: Stabilized Attention MIL for Visual Senescence Scoring at Small Sample Size
description:
Reference implementation and evaluation protocol for SA-MIL, accompanying the ISBI 2027 paper Automated Visual Senescence Scoring of Stem-Cell Cultures from Brightfield Microscopy: Stabilized Attention MIL at Small Sample Size. Contains the frozen-feature leave-one-sample-out protocol, the SA-MIL aggregator with all four ablation switches, baseline aggregators (mean-pool, max-pool, gated attention), permutation inference, and the per-run result table behind the paper's main table.

The microscopy images and extracted feature tensors are not included. The images are restricted and available from the authors on request; extracted features are derived from those images. The protocol is therefore fully inspectable and re-runnable, but exact numeric reproduction requires the private dataset.
